bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and bags larger than 16 × 16 × 8 inches are prohibited. The FAQ does not require clear bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue has no public parking; nearby paid lots and some street parking are available.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The shared venue FAQ does not specify a rideshare pickup or drop-off site for The Showbox.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue and its preshow lounge sell food or drinks and take major cards, not cash. Outside food, beverages and containers, including reusable water bottles, are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: All entries are accessible. Guests may purchase an accessible ticket through AXS, or if sold out, buy general admission and notify security of accessibility needs; dedicated accessible seating is not guaranteed.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The shared Showbox venue FAQ does not publish a rule for re-entry after leaving.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets may be collected only on show night at the The Showbox box office; bring the named buyer’s photo ID. The box office opens at the scheduled door time.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The box office opens at the scheduled door time. Guests age 21 or older purchasing preshow food or drinks in Kerns Music Shop may be admitted first when doors open; the lounge opens one hour before doors.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
